scope: Third Section 7 batch: Anton Mellit and Yongchang Zhu.

source_checks.compatibility_change: Removed five unsupported TeX negative-thin-space commands; no formula content changed.

methods: Parent read the Mellit branch, checked elementary proofs and examples, and checked HMMS Corollary 7.5 and Remark 8.15 against arXiv:2209.05429v2.
Independent read-only reviewer checked the Zhu branch against the published report and its specified primary references; both reported findings were corrected.
Writer packets provide versioned reading scope, per-page claims, proof boundaries and additional scoped calculations.
corrections: Canonical increasing nilpotent filtration uses the d-i threshold.
Hamiltonian signs, the origin-preserving subalgebra and central constants are distinguished.
The final Hamiltonian action on ordinary coprime stable Higgs moduli is included; the earlier restriction concerns the larger W algebra.
A separate positive Rouquier-complex atom and the existing Tor definition make the y-ification construction readable from linked prerequisites.
Loop Eisenstein inducing characters are explicitly trivial on rational torus points, with the stated rotation convention.
Zhu proceedings references use its actual Section 4 and equation/theorem labels.
exact_or_numerical_regressions: Principal sl2 operators on truncated polynomials.
Preservation of reviewed hypotheses and conjecture labels.
mathematical_review.proof_boundary: Elementary constructions and selected deductions are proved locally. Deep geometric and analytic theorems retain explicit citations; all remaining branches are listed per report. No claim to reconstruct every research proof.
mathematical_review.terminology: Existing terminology reused. BananaSpace search did not establish complete terminology alignment; no comprehensive verification is claimed.
